summary: Enforce last-in-first-out loading/unloading for the shipment.
businessRules: follow_lifo_order defines: Specify whether the shipment route should follow LIFO (last in, first out). Use this parameter when the loading or unloading sequence of cargo is important. The default value is \false\.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: follow_lifo_order true respected across concurrent shipments.
